CustomField.description: Controls how the FQS Gift Acknowledgement flow handles gifts at this donor grouping. Include All: every gift auto-emails. Exclude Lifetime: auto-email unless the donor is already a Lifetime Major donor (then creates a Task for personal outreach). Exclude All: always creates a Task. Flow defaults to Include All when blank.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Determines whether a gift at this donor grouping triggers an automatic acknowledgement email (Include All), a personal-touch task (Exclude All), or a lifetime-escalating hybrid (Exclude Lifetime). Configured per donor grouping — no code redeploy needed when changed.
CustomField.label: Auto Acknowledgement
